name: [⚡] Escape Maze For Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Escape Maze For Brainrots! 🧠🏃 

Explore the maze and collect Brainrots in the center! 🌀
Watch out... Sammy is chasing you down! 👀 🔥
Run back to your base before he catches you! 🏠💨
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and store extra Brainrots! 🏗️
Rebirth to move faster and escape easier! ⚡

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE!

👍 Don't forget to like the game if you enjoy it!
👾 Experience it on PC, mobile, tablet and Console!
